@graph.name: How to annotate any webpage with MarkLayer
@graph.description: Free and anonymous workflow for adding drawings, comments, arrows, and highlights to any live webpage and sharing them via a link. No install required for most sites.

step.name: Paste a URL on marklayer.app
step.text: Open marklayer.app and paste any URL into the annotation field. No install, no account, no sign-up. (For sites the web app cannot embed, install the optional free Chrome extension.)

step.name: Draw, comment, or highlight
step.text: Use the floating toolbar to draw freehand, add shapes or arrows, pin comments, or highlight elements directly on the live page.

step.name: Collaborate in real time
step.text: Invite others via the share link. Unlimited collaborators can annotate the same page together with live cursors and optional voice chat.

step.name: Share the link
step.text: Click Share to copy a single link. Send it to anyone. They can open it in any browser, no install or account required.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. 100% free. There is no paid plan, no trial period, no per-seat pricing, no usage cap, and no premium tier.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to install anything to use MarkLayer?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The web app at marklayer.app lets you paste any URL and start annotating directly in your browser. No install, no account, no sign-up. The free Chrome extension is optional, for sites the web app cannot embed (sites behind a login or with strict embed policies).
Yes. There is no sign-up, no email verification, no profile, and no login. MarkLayer generates a random local display name and color stored in your browser. No personal data is collected.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to create an account to use MarkLayer?

acceptedAnswer.text: No account is required. Open the web app at marklayer.app or install the free Chrome extension and start annotating. There is no registration step.

mainEntity.name: Does the other person need the extension installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Anyone can view your annotations via the share link. No install and no account required.

mainEntity.name: Does MarkLayer work on any website?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Production sites, staging URLs, internal tools, third-party pages. The web app works on any URL it can embed; the free Chrome extension covers sites behind a login or with strict embed policies.

mainEntity.name: Can multiple people annotate at the same time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Real-time live cursors and voice chat let unlimited collaborators work on the same page together.
